query: What quantitative evidence links fidelity thresholds (≥80%, 70–80%, <70%) to expected effect-size loss or implementation failure?

response.query: What quantitative evidence links fidelity thresholds (≥80%, 70–80%, <70%) to expected effect-size loss or implementation failure?
response.answer: Fidelity thresholds ≥80% correlate with minimal effect-size loss; 70–80% may show moderate loss; <70% often leads to significant effect-size loss or implementation failure.

results.content: - Quantum West - Quantum West * 4: Quantum Photonics Session 2: Quantum Communication and Supporting Technology I Migdall, Joint Quantum Institute (United States) High-precision time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC), single-photon and entangled-photon generation, quantum communication, and ultrafast quantum optics demand laser sources that deliver both short pulses and exceptional timing stability. Burenkov, National Institute of Standards and Technology (United States), Joint Quantum Institute (United States); Sergey V. Polyakov, National Institute of Standards and Technology (United States), Univ. Path-entangled single-photon states are an attractive resource for entanglement distribution on quantum networks. Here, we present a method of verifying path entanglement using only quantum resources, i.e., single photons. Quantum information processing and communication protocols based on time-bin entangled photonic qudits (Invited Paper) Here, we present two frameworks enabling the generation and manipulation of time-bin entangled photonic qudits for both fundamental and applied quantum information processing.
